problem: Official DeepSeek Markdown pages rejected by built-in Fetch with unsafe_url.
rootCause: System fake-IP proxy resolves api-docs.deepseek.com to 198.18.0.25, classified as reserved by general SSRF rules.
text/markdown was absent from direct Fetch content types, so removing only the DNS refusal would still fail.

fix.allowedProxyDns: All answers exclusively within 198.18.0.0/15 and no answer equals a local network interface.
retainedChecks: Arbitrary origins and paid tool endpoint/target validation remain strict
Each redirect revalidates origin/address before request
No authorization credentials sent when reading pages
fix.scope: Targeted vendor documentation compatibility, not generic fake-IP support for arbitrary web hosts.
